prompts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: Chinese typographic logo design proposal sheet, landscape 1536x1024.
Primary request: Design an original, highly polished bespoke four-character Chinese WORDMARK reading exactly "原木社区" for LogHome, a Minecraft fan-fiction reading/writing community. Concept A: warm timber joinery meets contemporary literary community. Focus on the four Chinese characters themselves, not a separate pictorial icon. This is real custom lettering with distinctive construction, not a standard font.
Letterform design: weighty, compact, confidently squared modern Chinese characters, softly eased corners, harmonious thick strokes and open counters. A few carefully chosen squared notch / mortise-and-tenon joins give a wooden construction logic; subtle block-cut terminals, no tiny details. The 木 character must keep its recognizable tree-like Chinese skeleton. 原 社 区 all structurally correct and instantly readable. Same visual height and balanced optical spacing. Friendly warmth and quiet confidence, excellent flat silhouette.
Color palette based on existing project UI: primary warm timber brown #79573C, secondary lighter wood #947358, paper #F5F1E8, ink #302F2A. Use a single solid brown for the main wordmark.
Composition: elegant spacious graphic design identity sheet with restrained Swiss grid. Warm paper background. Top-left small typography "A / 木构字标", top-right tiny "LOGHOME". Upper/middle main hero, the four-character horizontal wordmark large, centered, with ample clear space. Fine horizontal rule at two-thirds. Lower third contains three well separated demonstrations: a smaller black single-color horizontal wordmark on paper; identical letterforms reversed in ivory on a flat dark brown rectangular panel; a tight stacked two-line wordmark 原木 above 社区 inside a small flat square. Reuse EXACT same glyph construction across these variations. A tiny bottom row of three color swatches with hex labels "#79573C", "#947358", "#F5F1E8".
Text verbatim only: "A / 木构字标", "LOGHOME", "原木社区", "原木", "社区", "#79573C", "#947358", "#F5F1E8". Chinese reading order 原 木 社 区. No other text.
Constraints: flat vector-style shapes with crisp contours, exact Chinese orthography, all characters fully visible. Wordmark is the centerpiece. No stock font appearance, no tree illustration, no leaf, no house icon, no mascot, no wood grain, no gradients, no shadows, no texture, no 3D, no stationery mockups, no imitation of the Minecraft official logo, no watermark.

Large orange four-character horizontal wordmark in upper/middle hero area, plenty of air. Thin horizontal rule at two-thirds. Lower third contains three smaller applications with IDENTICAL letterform design: charcoal monochrome horizontal wordmark on warm white; ivory reversed wordmark on a flat orange rectangle; compact two-line square wordmark with 原木 above 社区. Tiny footer color swatches and exact hex labels "#FF7028", "#302F2A", "#FFF8F1".
